architecture: LayerNorm(516) -> 2-layer BiLSTM(192, bidirectional) -> Temporal Attention + Max Pooling -> MLP Classifier (domain-adversarial signer head used only during training, not exported)

feature_layout.velocity_258: [258:516] frame-to-frame delta of the raw_258 block, same layout, first frame delta = 0

normalization.center: midpoint of pose landmarks 23 (L hip) and 24 (R hip)
normalization.scale: distance between pose landmarks 11 (L shoulder) and 12 (R shoulder)
normalization.applied_to: pose xyz, left hand xyz, right hand xyz -- NOT visibility
